project.name: 2c2a 主页
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 企业安全管控平台落地页，紫蓝品牌色(#4b3fe3)，冷色调专业科技感，简洁大气，Desktop 优先响应式
project.designRead: SaaS landing / IT decision maker / calm enterprise trust / low density / avoid purple neon AI hero

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: single brand hue #4b3fe3 used for CTA, accent highlights, and interactive states
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: no secondary/accent brand hue; identity uses neutral tints or primary tints

styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + PingFang SC + Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif throughout, display 48px/700, h1 36px/700, h2 28px/600
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px base scale up to 96px, generous section padding (80-96px)
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: clean bordered cards, border-first surfaces, subtle hover transitions
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: white cards with thin borders (0.08 alpha) as default; shadow only for floating layers, max alpha 0.05
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: professional tech imagery, clean icon lines
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: subtle hover/focus feedback, refined button/card transitions

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: fixed top navbar with brand logo left, navigation center, login CTA right
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter + PingFang SC + Microsoft YaHei sans-serif
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: brand color filled rounded button, login outline button

designSource.designDecisionSummary: 企业安全管控平台，紫蓝品牌色(#4b3fe3)，Inter字体，克制圆角，边框优先表面

pages.title: 主页
pages.businessScenario: public landing page for 2c2a platform, first impression, brand trust, login entry
pages.visualNorthStar: 专业科技感落地页，紫蓝渐变hero区域，简洁信任信号，右上角登录入口
pages.compositionPattern: Hero-centered with feature grid below and trust footer
